> Per site, the effect of a per-run trait on logit occupancy, from a random-intercept mixed model per site, so that repeated runs of one biological replicate are not counted as independent.

Wire verb `ptmqtl trait-effects` · Python [`pymzlib.ptmqtl.trait_effects`][pymzlib.ptmqtl.trait_effects]

### Wraps

- [`SiteTraitEffects.Fit`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`SiteTraitOptions`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`SiteTraitEffect`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteTraitEffects.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`
- [`SiteRunOccupancy`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/mzLib/blob/d10017ce/mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs) in `mzLib/Quantification/PtmQtl/SiteOccupancy.cs` at mzLib `d10017ce`

### Parameters

| Parameter | Type | Default | Unit | Range | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `occupancy` | `path` | required | — | — | The occupancy table ptmqtl occupancy --out writes, one row per (site, run). Columns are found by header name: protein_accession, position (1-based), residue (one letter), modification, run, state (quantified, floor, count_only or not_detected), modified_intensity and covering_intensity (instrument units, finite), unmodified_quantified (true or false), and optionally fraction (fraction, 0 to 1; blank for none), which mzLib then uses instead of modified_intensity / covering_intensity, as it does for a fraction a producer wrote exactly. site_key and category are derived by mzLib and not read; any other column is listed in ignored_columns. A (site, run) given twice is refused, since mzLib's fit would use the first. |
| `runs` | `path` | required | — | — | A TSV with a header row, then one row per run: the run (as the occupancy table names it), its biological replicate (the random-intercept group, for example the animal or donor), the trait (its header names the trait; any unit, which effect is then per), then any covariates (each header names one; every value finite for a run with a trait). Columns are by position. A run with a blank, NA or NaN trait is not used, as mzLib reads a run absent from the trait. A run of the occupancy table missing here is not used either, and is listed in occupancy_runs_not_used. |
| `min_runs` (wire `--min-runs`) | `int` | `mzLib's SiteTraitOptions.MinRuns, 6 at the pin` | runs | `>= 0` | The fewest runs contributing a response for a site to be fitted; fewer is below_support. Absent, the bridge sets nothing and mzLib's default applies. |
| `min_replicates` (wire `--min-replicates`) | `int` | `mzLib's SiteTraitOptions.MinReplicates, 4 at the pin` | replicates | `>= 0` | The fewest distinct biological replicates among those runs; fewer is below_support. Absent, mzLib's default applies. |
| `logit_epsilon` (wire `--logit-epsilon`) | `float` | `mzLib's SiteTraitOptions.LogitEpsilon, 5e-5 at the pin (half the 4-decimal resolution of stored fractions)` | fraction (0 to 1) | `> 0 and < 0.5` | Each fraction is clamped to [epsilon, 1 - epsilon] before the logit, so 0 and 1 have finite logits. Absent, mzLib's default applies. |
| `keep_ceiling` (wire `--keep-ceiling`) | `flag` | `absent: mzLib's SiteTraitOptions.ExcludeCeiling, true at the pin, so ceilings are left out` | — | — | Use a run where the site was seen only modified (a fraction of 1 with unmodified_quantified false) as a response, clamped below 1. mzLib leaves such a ceiling out unless asked. |

### Returns

Top-level fields:

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `occupancy_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the occupancy table. |
| `runs_file` | `string` | — | never | Absolute path of the runs table. |
| `trait_name` | `string` | — | never | The runs table's third header: the trait. |
| `covariate_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The runs table's headers after the trait, in order; empty without covariates. covariate_effects follows this order. |
| `cell_count` | `int` | cells | never | Occupancy rows read. |
| `run_count` | `int` | runs | never | Runs in the runs table. |
| `trait_run_count` | `int` | runs | never | Runs with a trait value: the runs the design is built over. |
| `occupancy_runs_not_used` | `string[]` | — | never | Runs of the occupancy table with no trait value in the runs table, in ordinal order; their cells were not used. |
| `min_runs` | `int` | runs | never | The support threshold used: as given, or mzLib's default. |
| `min_replicates` | `int` | replicates | never | The replicate threshold used: as given, or mzLib's default. |
| `logit_epsilon` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | never | The clamp used: as given, or mzLib's default. |
| `exclude_ceiling` | `bool` | — | never | Whether ceiling cells were left out: false with --keep-ceiling, else mzLib's default. |
| `status_counts` | `map<string,int>` | sites | never | Sites per status, keyed by every status value. |
| `ignored_columns` | `string[]` | — | never | Columns of the occupancy file that were not read (other than site_key and category); empty when none. |
| `row_count` | `int` | rows | never | Sites in the table. |
| `column_names` | `string[]` | — | never | The table's columns, in order. |
| `columns` | `table` | — | never | One row per site with at least one usable response (a quantified cell, not a ceiling unless --keep-ceiling, in a run with a trait), in ordinal site_key order. |
| `caveats` | `string[]` | — | never | Six static caveats; plus one listing occupancy runs not used, one counting sites not fitted by status, and one naming columns not read, when they apply. |

Per-row fields (one value per record, in `columns` or each list entry):

| Field | Type | Unit | Null? | Meaning |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `site_key` | `string` | — | never | mzLib's ModificationSite.Key, as ptmqtl occupancy writes it. |
| `protein_accession` | `string` | — | never | The site's protein. |
| `position` | `int` | — | never | 1-based residue position, as ptmqtl occupancy. |
| `residue` | `string` | — | never | The one-letter residue. |
| `modification` | `string` | — | never | Category:IdWithMotif. |
| `status` | `string` | — | never | fitted \| below_support (fewer runs or replicates than min_runs or min_replicates) \| too_few_observations \| rank_deficient \| too_few_groups \| variance_ratio_at_limit \| not_converged (mzLib's MixedModel could not fit it, as stats fit names those outcomes). Only fitted rows carry statistics. |
| `effect` | `float` | logit occupancy per trait unit | yes: not fitted (see status) | The change in logit(occupancy) per unit of the trait, other covariates held fixed. exp(effect) is the odds ratio of the modified form per trait unit. |
| `standard_error` | `float` | logit occupancy per trait unit | yes: not fitted | Standard error of effect. |
| `df` | `float` | degrees of freedom | yes: not fitted | Denominator degrees of freedom of the t test, by nlme's containment rule: for a trait constant within each replicate, replicates - 1 - the between-replicate coefficients. |
| `p_value` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | yes: not fitted | Two-sided p-value of the trait coefficient. |
| `q` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | yes: not fitted, so not in the family | Benjamini-Hochberg over the sites with a p-value in this call. Not a target-decoy q-value. |
| `runs` | `int` | runs | never | Runs contributing a response. |
| `replicates` | `int` | replicates | never | Distinct biological replicates among those runs. |
| `median_fraction` | `float` | fraction (0 to 1) | never | Median occupancy over the contributing runs, before the clamp. |
| `covariate_effects` | `float[]` | logit occupancy per covariate unit | never | One coefficient per covariate, in covariate_names order; each element null when the site was not fitted. Empty without covariates. |
| `replicate_variance` | `float` | squared logit occupancy | yes: not fitted | Between-replicate variance of logit occupancy (the random intercept). |
| `residual_variance` | `float` | squared logit occupancy | yes: not fitted | Within-replicate (run-to-run) variance of logit occupancy. |

### Errors

| Kind | pyMzLib raises | When |
|---|---|---|
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | occupancy or runs missing, blank or not found; min-runs or min-replicates not an integer or below 0; logit-epsilon not a number, or not above 0 and below 0.5; an option given without a value; keep-ceiling written with a value |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | the occupancy file empty, header-only, missing a column, with a repeated column name, a row of the wrong width, a position that is not an integer, a residue that is not one letter, a state that is not one of the four, an intensity that is not finite, a fraction that is not a number, unmodified_quantified not true or false, an empty accession, modification or run, or a (site, run) twice |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | the runs file with fewer than three columns, a repeated header after the replicate, a row of the wrong width, an empty or repeated run, or a trait or covariate that is not a number |
| `usage` | [`UsageError`][pymzlib.UsageError] | mzLib refuses the input, in its own words: a run with a trait and no replicate; a run with a trait whose covariates are not all finite; a design (intercept, trait, covariates over the runs with a trait) not of full column rank, such as a constant trait |
| `correctness` | [`BridgeError`][pymzlib.BridgeError] | never expected |
| `service_unavailable` | [`ServiceUnavailableError`][pymzlib.ServiceUnavailableError] | never raised by this verb |

### Caveats

- Per site, logit(occupancy) = b0 + b_trait trait + the covariates + a random intercept per biological replicate + error, fitted by REML (mzLib's MixedModel). Repeated runs of one replicate (technical injections) are not counted as independent: a trait constant within each replicate is tested at the between-replicate degrees of freedom.
- Only quantified cells are responses; floor, count_only and not_detected cells are left out, never entered as 0. This is the intensity part of the question: it says nothing about whether detecting the modification changes with the trait.
- Ceiling cells are left out unless keep-ceiling.
- Fractions are clamped to [logit_epsilon, 1 - logit_epsilon] before the logit. effect is per unit of the trait as given: rescale the trait to change the unit.
- A site with fewer than min_runs runs or min_replicates replicates is below_support, with null statistics; a site with no usable response does not appear.
- q adjusts over this call's fitted sites only: not across datasets, and not a target-decoy q-value.

### Example

```python
result = pymzlib.ptmqtl.trait_effects('trait_occupancy.tsv', 'trait_runs.tsv')
```

Recorded from the live bridge as [`ptmqtl_trait_effects.json`](https://github.com/smith-chem-wisc/pyMzLib/blob/main/pkg/python/tests/fixtures/ptmqtl_trait_effects.json). The doctests in the API reference replay these recordings in CI.

```python
result = pymzlib.ptmqtl.trait_effects('trait_occupancy.tsv', 'trait_runs.tsv', min_replicates=6)
```
